description: Shenwan (申万) industry index board for a trading day: close, change %, turnover rate, trading amount (unit as published), share of market turnover, P/E, P/B and dividend yield for every Shenwan level-1 (31 industries), level-2 (131) or level-3 (336) industry. Answers "申万一级行业涨跌幅", "Shenwan industry PE PB", "which Shenwan industry rose most on 2026-11-06", "半导体 801081 市盈率 市净率", "SW industry valuation ranking", "行业估值". Filter to one industry with `code` (e.g. 801081 semiconductors, level 2) and rank with `sort`. Up/down stock counts, limit-up counts and 20-day highs per industry are NOT published by this source and are listed under not_provided. Source: Shenwan Hongyuan Research, SW industry index daily publication.

code.description: One 6-digit Shenwan industry code, e.g. "801080" (Electronics, L1) or "801081" (Semiconductors, L2).

date.description: Trading day, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD (default: latest published trading day). A non-trading date returns found:false with the nearest prior trading day.

level.description: Shenwan industry level: 1 (31 industries, default), 2 (131) or 3 (336). A code given in `code` selects its level automatically.

limit.description: Max rows returned, 1-400 (default: all rows of the level).

sort.description: Sort descending by this field (default: by code).

name: ashares_sw_industries
